HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Solitaire, often referring to Klondike, Spider, or FreeCell, is a classic single-player card game. The goal is to arrange all cards into foundation piles by suit and rank.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Set up the tableau with seven columns of cards.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Move cards between columns, following suit and rank rules.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Build foundation piles from Ace to King.
